# FBX material fixtures

**最終更新:** 2026-11-13

Project-authored synthetic cubes, generated by
`python tools/fbx/create_material_fixtures.py`. No downloaded model data is used.

- `diffuse-factor.fbx`: a Phong diffuse-factor image is not a metallic/roughness map.
- `separate-pbr.fbx`: a single material with red-channel metallic=0.2 and
  roughness=0.8 maps. Other channels deliberately differ, to detect accidental
  use as packed B/G channels.
- `scalar-reference.fbx`: the same material expressed as constant factors, for GPU comparison.
- `multi-material-pbr.fbx`: two cube face groups with distinct base color and
  metallic/roughness scalar materials, for Importer, Raster, and RT slot-boundary
  checks.
- `external/FBX/stale-source-path.fbx`: a stale absolute texture path with its
  image in the sibling `external/Textures/` folder, to test bounded asset-folder
  recovery without embedding an external model in the repository.
- `fabric-pillow/fabric-pillow.fbx`: a legacy-named folder containing a
  project-authored six-part upholstered sofa (split seat cushions, continuous
  back, and arms).
  A dark studio cove and wooden support legs are added by the RT capture test.
  The 512² woven base-color, roughness, and tangent-normal maps are generated
  alongside it; no downloaded model or image data is used. `manifest.json`
  records SHA-256 hashes.

The fixture geometry, FBX text and PNG pixels are authored for ArtifactStudio tests
and may be redistributed with the project.
